issues.issue: Whether the LTTE-suspicion and detention account is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says authorities arrested, beat and questioned him over LTTE suspicion and still seek him.
issues.result_text: Claimant's account disbelieved; negative credibility finding on suspicion, checkpoints, passport and departure.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is of particular interest to authorities or fits a risk profile
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he fits the profile of Tamil males accepted in Canada and is of some interest to authorities.
issues.result_text: Cannot find for claimant on profile alone; not shown to be of particular interest to authorities.
Psychological report given little weight; it rests on the claimant's own account and does not prove the cause.

issues.issue: Whether return would expose the claimant to torture or cruel treatment (s.97)
issues.result_text: Claimant not shown to face substantial danger of torture or cruel treatment given Sri Lanka's record.
